newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African banks must rationalise -Nedcor.
newsitem.headline: S.African banks must rationalise -Nedcor.

text.p: The South African banking sector must undergo a rationalisation for survival and this could mean mergers, Nedcor senior chairman Chris Liebenberg said on Thursday.

"If you look at what's happening you have to ask yourself what do we have to do to survive. It is inevitable that some rationalisation will take place in the South African banking sector," Liebenberg said at the group's results presentation.
Asked about market speculation that Nedcor was planning to take over First National Bank, Liebenberg said:
"At this point in time management has not spoken to any other management. Directors have not spoken to any other directors and the chairmen have not spoken."

Liebenberg cited the recent link-up between Boland Bank Ltd and NBS Holdings as the start of a restructuring in South African banking but he would not say which banks were likley to join forces in future.
"It could be Nedcor, it cold be FNB, it could be Stanbic (Standard Bank Investment Corp ). I don't know," he said.
